cues: The Eustachian tube links the middle ear to the throat and equalises pressure, which is why your ears pop on the drive up to Muktinath.
And the inner ear also balances you: three semicircular canals at right angles sense rotation, while the utriculus and sacculus, with their tiny stones, sense which way is up.
